response.sql: WITH qc_funding_groups AS (SELECT COALESCE(projects.fundflux, 'Missing') AS fundflux, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scanqc JOIN projects ON scanqc.arcref = projects.arcregistry GROUP BY COALESCE(projects.fundflux, 'Missing')), totals AS (SELECT SUM(count) AS total_count, COUNT(*) AS num_funding_sources FROM qc_funding_groups) SELECT qc_funding_groups.fundflux, qc_funding_groups.count, CAST(qc_funding_groups.count AS REAL) / totals.total_count AS fraction_of_total, CAST(qc_funding_groups.count * totals.num_funding_sources AS REAL) / totals.total_count AS count_divided_by_average FROM qc_funding_groups CROSS JOIN totals ORDER BY qc_funding_groups.fundflux
